_about: Music the weekly ads (tools/weekly_video.py) may use. Files live on the PC in MUSIC_DIR (default %USERPROFILE%\Music\Copyright Free Music), never in this public repo. Only tracks under 'approved' are ever picked. Licence checked 2026-11-15 from each track's own description/source. A shop ad is commercial use: 'free for personal use' or 'non-monetised only' is NOT enough.
